Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Suraj Kumar Tiwari  Mr.Shambhu Narayan Singh  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Umeshanand Pandit  For the O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Dinesh Jha  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 07-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State as well as learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2.

2. This application has been filed for quashing of the F.I.R. i.e. Ahiyapur P.S. Case No. 415 of 2013 for the offences punishable under Sections 406/420/120(B)/467/408/471/465 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 37/38 of the N.I. Act.
3. Both the parties have settled their dispute with regard to the bouncing of cheque of Rupees One Lakh.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has handed over a demand draft of Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand to Mr. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.80747 of 2023(2) dt.07-10-2024 Dinesh Jha,
learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party No. 2.
